user.title: Connect browser-daemon
user.description: Home Assistant runs the HR WORKS scripts through the browser-daemon run API. Select the Browser Daemon integration to use, or turn on the override to enter the URL of any node and the cluster secret instead. A blank secret keeps the saved one. The profile keeps the employee login; the integration signs in to it itself. Employee login follows in the next step.

account.title: Your employee account
account.description: Use your employee login with a password and optional TOTP URI, or select an rbw integration and item ID. rbw supplies fresh username, password and current authenticator codes; the username must match. Leave both rbw fields empty for direct credentials. Blank direct secret fields keep saved values.

error.worker_auth: browser-daemon rejected the cluster secret. Check it.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach browser-daemon. Check the URL, the cluster secret or the Browser Daemon integration.
error.browser_unavailable: The browser is unavailable. Check the browser-daemon profile name and that runs are enabled on its node.
error.incompatible_worker: browser-daemon does not serve runs. Enable runs on the node (--run-node).
error.invalid_auth: Login failed. Check the company ID, user ID and password.
error.invalid_code: The authenticator code was rejected or the challenge expired. Try a fresh code, or restart authentication.
error.unsupported_mfa: HR WORKS asks for a second factor that this login cannot complete. Set up Authenticator (TOTP) as your second factor in HR WORKS, then try again.
error.session_expired: The employee session expired. Authenticate again.
error.different_account: This entry belongs to a different employee. Add another integration entry for a different account.
error.portal_changed: The portal could not be read reliably. Check for portal changes and update the integration.
error.busy: The browser is busy. Try again shortly.
error.not_found: The employee session was not found. Start authentication again.
error.invalid_request: The request was rejected. Check the URL, cluster secret and profile.
error.invalid_totp: Invalid TOTP URI. Use otpauth://totp/... with a Base32 secret and six digits.
error.login_timeout: The HR WORKS login did not reach a known login step in time. Try again later; if it persists, check the portal in a browser.
error.rbw_incomplete: Select both an rbw integration and an item ID, or leave both empty for direct credentials.
error.rbw_unavailable: Could not read the selected rbw account. Unlock the vault and check item and field permissions, then retry.

abort.already_configured: This employee account is already configured.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: This entry belongs to a different employee. Add another integration entry for a different account.

init.title: Employee data settings
init.description: Choose calendar coverage and update frequency. Working-time submissions require this option; previews always remain available.

login.title: Sign in again
login.description: Continue with the configured employee login. rbw supplies fresh credentials and authenticator codes when selected; otherwise the saved password and TOTP URI are used. Enter a six-digit code if needed. Change the credential source through Reconfigure.

worker_auth.title: browser-daemon access needs attention
worker_auth.description: browser-daemon rejected the cluster secret for {name}. Reconfigure the connection.

confirm.title: Reload HR WORKS
confirm.description: browser-daemon or its browser for {name} is unavailable. Reload the integration to re-establish the connection.

portal_changed.title: HR WORKS portal changed
portal_changed.description: The scripts cannot reliably read {name}. Update the integration for the current portal layout. Missing values are unavailable; they are never replaced with zero.

confirm.title: Working time reviewed
confirm.description: Review the affected day directly in HR WORKS. Confirm only after checking which entries were saved and whether an open draft needs removal. This confirmation clears the repair notice; it does not change working times.

reconfigure_required.title: Reconfigure for browser-daemon
reconfigure_required.description: {name} used the SSH worker, which was removed. Open the integration, choose Reconfigure and enter the browser-daemon connection and profile.

select_account.message: Select one loaded HR WORKS account using config_entry_id.

writes_disabled.message: Enable working-time submissions in integration options before saving entries.

reconfigure_required.message: This account used the removed SSH worker. Reconfigure it to use browser-daemon.

cannot_connect.message: Cannot reach browser-daemon. Check the Browser Daemon integration or the configured URL.

record_working_time.name: Record working time
record_working_time.description: Preview or submit one completed interval. Lunch breaks and doctor appointments remain separate entries.

dry_run.name: Preview only
dry_run.description: Check the interval and overlaps without saving anything.

restart_browser_session.name: Restart browser session
restart_browser_session.description: Terminate any active HR WORKS browser session in browser-daemon and trigger a fresh poll.
